context_requirements: Cells must express PFKFB3 and rely on glycolysis for ATP and biosynthetic precursors.
Cells with high glycolytic flux and active PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling are more sensitive.
Cells with functional TP53 can mount a p21-mediated cytostatic response; TP53-mutant lines may show weaker early arrest.
Hepatocyte-like lines with high basal glycolytic and lipogenic gene expression (e.g., HEPG2) may show stronger transcriptional responses.
falsifiers: No decrease in glycolytic or lipogenic gene expression (e.g., HK1, ALDOA, GAPDH, ACLY, HMGCR) at 6 or 24 h in any responsive line.
No induction of HIF1A, DDIT4, or TRIB3 at 6 h despite expected metabolic stress.
No reduction in proliferation or cell-cycle genes (e.g., CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1) at 24 h.
A response pattern indistinguishable from generic cytotoxicity without any glycolysis-related transcriptional signature.
Stronger responses in non-glycolytic or low-PFKFB3 lines than in glycolytic lines.
